_comment: Bible des decors. Le Marais doit se ressembler d'une clairiere a l'autre :
meme lumiere, meme vegetation, meme sol. Meme regle que les deux autres

characters.look: CLEARING 1: a wide muddy roundabout where three paths meet, floor of unstable soaked VIOLET mud and stagnant BLUE pools, coils of WHITE mist, ringed by stunted twisted BLACK trees.
CLEARING 3: a small clearing overgrown with tall GREEN grass, heavy still air, three narrow paths leaving south, east and west between close BLACK trees.
CLEARING 4, THE WOLF MASTER'S: a grassy clearing with a small sturdy log house of ORANGE-brown timber at its centre, GREEN grass around it, dark BLACK forest behind.
CLEARING 5, THE BATTLEFIELD: trampled GREEN grass marked by a recent fight, two WHITE arrows still planted in a tree trunk, tracks leading east and west.
CLEARING 7, THE GIANT'S: an open clearing whose VIOLET mud is pressed with enormous nail-studded boot-prints half a metre long.
CLEARING 8, THE FROG MASTER'S: a clearing dotted with BLUE ponds, giant WHITE-capped mushrooms rising at its centre, croaking on every side.
CLEARING 9, THE BRIGANDS': a rough camp in a clearing, a low fire and bundles under the trees, seen from the cover of a large BLACK tree.
CLEARING 11: a vast clearing on drier rising ground at the forest edge, scattered GREEN bushes, deep silent shadow between tall BLACK trees.
CLEARING 12: a firm-floored clearing holding several large flat WHITE stones and one massive hollow log, two paths beyond.
CLEARING 14, THE TROPICAL: a lush jungle-like clearing, dense bright GREEN foliage, hanging creepers, colourful birds among the branches.
CLEARING 15: a calm twilight clearing; to the west the mouth of a muddy overgrown path, other trails south and east under the trees.
CLEARING 16, THE EYRIE: a clearing around one great lone tree carrying a gigantic nest of woven branches high in its crown.

CLEARING 17, THE SPIDER MASTER'S: a clearing hung with a few THICK WHITE spiderwebs, each strand broad as a rope, strung between the trees; a sumptuous VIOLET tent pitched firmly ON THE GROUND at its centre. Simple bold shapes only, no fine filament detail.

CLEARING 18, THE SWORD-TREES': a tiny clearing seen at eye level; a floor of GREEN grass broken by patches of VIOLET mud, tightly ringed by small ORDINARY squat trees whose BLACK trunks and branches read clearly against their GREEN foliage -- perfectly normal trees: no arms, no hands, no swords (their transformation belongs to the attack scenes only). A band of deep BLUE sky above the treetops.
CLEARING 19: a rocky clearing among big BLACK boulders, WHITE fog drawn as a few large flat solid banks lying between the rocks -- never wisps, curls or smoke.
CLEARING 20, THE CLIFFTOP: a bare rocky summit high above a wide muddy BLUE river; crocodiles float far below, a bridge visible far to the east.
CLEARING 21, THE CRYSTAL POOL'S: a grassy dead-end clearing holding a pool of crystal-clear BLUE water edged by a small WHITE sand beach, one single path out.
CLEARING 23, THE FLOWERS': a widening path bordered by banks of too-beautiful ORANGE and VIOLET flowers, unnaturally perfect.
CLEARING 24, THE PINCER GRASS': a pleasant-looking clearing of tall GREEN grass that visibly moves and grows, two paths out.
CLEARING 25, THE POOL BEAST'S: a clearing around a dark BLUE pool, its surface heaving with slow ripples.
CLEARING 26, THE ORCS': a scrubby clearing of GREEN brush and VIOLET mud, low cover along its edges; empty ground -- no arrows, no weapons, no figures.
CLEARING 27, THE GARDEN MASTER'S: a welcoming tended clearing, neatly trimmed GREEN bushes and beds of ORANGE and VIOLET flowers on every side.
CLEARING 28, THE SLIME POOL'S: a sodden clearing reachable by one path only, curled around a large pool whose surface is covered with greenish OOZE.
CLEARING 29, THE UNICORN'S: a gentle grassy hollow, soft GREEN grass at its centre, quiet and ringed by trees.
CLEARING 30, THE QUICKSAND'S: a clearing ringed by trees whose trunks are covered in GREEN ivy, floor of soft treacherous VIOLET sand, no path out.

CLEARING 32, THE FALLEN TREES': a small clearing under a solid BLACK sky -- NO white sky, no clouds; several BLACK trees lie fallen on GREEN grass and VIOLET mud, one large trunk across the middle, a plain BLACK forest wall behind. Landscape framing at the 35:24 screen ratio (about 1400x960 pixels) -- not ultrawide, not panoramic.
CLEARING 33, THE RIVERBANK: a small clearing on the bank of the Foul River, wide slow BLUE water stretching two hundred metres to the far shore.
CLEARING 34, THE DEEP FORD: a clearing cut by a deep river, BLUE water swirling in eddies over an unseen bed.
CLEARING 35, THE BRIDGE'S: a thinning of the trees where the Foul River crosses east-west, spanned by a lone wooden bridge, apparently deserted.
THE SWAMP (the world of every scene): flat wetland under a BLACK sky, standing BLUE water, tussocks of coarse GREEN reeds, VIOLET mud, bare BLACK tree trunks; heavy still air, no horizon line.
A CLEARING: a roughly circular opening in the swamp, ringed by close BLACK trunks, floor of GREEN grass and VIOLET mud, one or more narrow paths leading out.
A PATH: a narrow trail of packed VIOLET earth between walls of GREEN reeds, running straight out of frame.

STRATAGUS'S TOWER: a squat BLACK stone tower, every edge and course of its stonework marked by THICK WHITE contour lines so the silhouette reads against the dark sky; stone gargoyles jutting from its parapet; a single iron door bearing a carved hideous face; BLACK bats wheeling around its top.
THE POOL: still BLUE water in a ring of WHITE sand, a small beach on one side, GREEN reeds behind.
characters.scale: three times the hero's height, filling half the frame

characters.look: THE RIVER: a wide slow BLUE river winding between VIOLET muddy banks, GREEN weed trailing in the current; the banks lined with tufts of GREEN reeds and bare BLACK swamp trees giving the scene depth -- not empty bands of flat colour.
BOURBENVILLE: a handful of low ORANGE-thatched huts at the swamp's edge, a rutted VIOLET track between them.
THE GIANT MUSHROOMS: pale WHITE stalks taller than a man, ORANGE caps, growing in clusters.
THE GARDEN: cultivated rows of GREEN plants inside a low stone wall, ORANGE blossoms, unnaturally orderly for the swamp.
COURBENSAULE: a hamlet of leaning WHITE-walled houses under enormous drooping GREEN willows, at the far edge of the swamp.
